def: An open-source PyTorch library for 8-bit and 4-bit quantization, including the NF4 data type, that quantizes weights at load time without calibration and also provides 8-bit optimizers.
practice: The quickest way to load a model in 4 bits in Transformers and the basis of QLoRA fine-tuning; weight-only, so it saves memory more than it speeds up serving.
